items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: Probably Big Chief Russell Moore or somebody like that playing from home.

ctx.x: What else? Could you tell me that story again about Zutty? About Zutty? If that's worth telling again. Oh, I...

About Zutty and Red Island for what it says. I thought it... Well, I just thought it was amusing. It about fell off the bandstand. This was at one of the jazz jam session halls where maybe two bands would get together to jam a little bit at the end of each set, you know. It was kind of a nice life. Each band played half an hour. Half hour on, half hour off, which is certainly not going to kill you. And it was good for the crowd because they got continuous live vital music. But the Janus Band was on the bill plus…
